name: grok
fix_description: In swapTokensForEth, the amountOutMin parameter is set to 0 (no slippage protection). Fix by calculating a reasonable minimum output amount based on an oracle price or TWAP, rejecting swaps that would execute at a significantly worse price than expected. This prevents sandwich attacks on the tax-swap mechanism.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a straightforward lack-of-access-control exploit: the attacker simply acquires LP tokens, deposits them, then directly calls an unrestricted updatePool to set an absurd rewardPerBlock and claims rewards. It is a short, linear attack with minimal protocol complexity and no flash loans, reentrancy, or deep accounting reasoning required.
